summary: Public projects created on 6 May 2026: 10 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Agent plugins for Claude covered decision logging, document nudging, and Linux audio preset management, alongside work-in-progress skill baskets for Israeli mortgage and property research. Documentation and datasets centred on Israeli open data, with bilingual catalogue translations and a reference snapshot of data.gov.il.

projects.name: Claude Decision Mapper
projects.description: A repository for mapping and codifying an iterative spec-refinement process used with Claude (and applicable to other LLM-driven planning conversations).

projects.name: Claude Document Nudge
projects.description: A snippet (and thin plugin wrapper) that nudges Claude to document decisions, todos, sprints, and handovers as we work — without being asked each time.

projects.name: Claude Shopping Demo 2
projects.description: model for a claude shopping research tool customised by shops + tasks

projects.name: Easy Effects Manager
projects.description: Claude-Controller plugin for managing Easy Effects on Linux: preset library, autoload bindings, level testing, voice-dictation setup

projects.name: Israel Agent Skills Dev Index
projects.description: Index of WIP skills-development repos feeding into Israel-Agent-Skills-Dev / Claude-Israel-Agent-Skills-Plugin.

projects.name: Israel Mortgage Research Skills
projects.description: WIP skills basket for Israeli residential mortgage research (track mix, BoI rules, DSR/LTV, bank quirks). Verified skills graduate to Israel-Agent-Skills-Dev.

projects.name: Israel Open Data Catalogue Translations
projects.description: Hebrew/English translation mapping for every dataset on data.gov.il

projects.name: Israel Open Data Resources
projects.description: Open access data and a list of Israeli data projects

projects.name: Israel Property Research Skills
projects.description: WIP skills basket for Israeli property due diligence (Tabu, tik binyan, shimush choreg, comps). Verified skills graduate to Israel-Agent-Skills-Dev.

projects.name: Israel Open Data Catalogue
projects.description: A bilingual (Hebrew/English) snapshot of the entire dataset catalogue published on data.gov.il, Israel's official open-data portal.
